xc_files.plain_code:
; hud program
var $blue2 = color(45, 160, 210)
var $blue3 = color(60, 180, 220)
var $white2 = color(90, 90, 90)
var $red2 = color(230, 15, 2)
update
	var $numpad = input_number("numpad", 0)
	output_number("beacon", 2, $numpad)
	var $beacon_x = input_number("beacon", 2)
	var $beacon_y = input_number("beacon", 3)
	var $beacon_z = input_number("beacon", 4)
	var $beacon_distance = input_number("beacon", 1)
	var $bluevar = 0
	
	$beacon_distance = round($beacon_distance)
	;print($beacon_distance, $beacon_x, $beacon_y, $beacon_z)
	var $beacon_tracker = 10+$beacon_distance*-0.00055
	if $beacon_tracker < 1
		$beacon_tracker = 2
	
	var $s = screen("hud", 0)
	$s.blank(0)
	$s.draw_line($s.width/2-7, $s.height/2, $s.width/2-21, $s.height/2, white)
	$s.draw_line($s.width/2+7, $s.height/2, $s.width/2+21, $s.height/2, white)
	$s.draw_circle($s.width/2, $s.height/2, 3, white)
	if sign($beacon_z) == 1
		$bluevar = $red2
		$s.write($s.width/2-32, $s.height/2+56, $red2, "Anti-target")
	else
		$bluevar = $blue2
		$s.write($s.width/2-17, $s.height/2+56, $blue2, "Target")
	$s.draw_circle($s.width/2+$beacon_x*185, $s.height/2-$beacon_y*150-8, $beacon_tracker, $bluevar)
	if $beacon_x < -0.5
		$s.draw_rect(0, 25, 8, 125, $blue3, $blue3)
	if $beacon_x > 0.5
		$s.draw_rect(192, 25, 200, 125, $blue3, $blue3)
	if $beacon_y > 0.48
		$s.draw_rect(50, 0, 150, 8, $blue3, $blue3)
	if $beacon_y < -0.48
		$s.draw_rect(50, 142, 150, 150, $blue3, $blue3)
		
	$s.write($s.width/2-10, $s.height/2-65, white, $beacon_distance:text & "m")
	
	var $isrecieve = input_number("beacon", 5)
	if $isrecieve == 0
		$s.blank(0)
		$s.write($s.width/2-39, $s.height/2-8, red, "No beacon found")
		$s.write($s.width/2-40, $s.height/2-8, $red2, "No beacon found")
